prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” orthodontist in Phoenix—especially because the right choice differs for kids, complex bite correction, adult Invisalign, budget, and insurance.

For braces or Invisalign, I’d prioritize an **orthodontist** (not a general dentist who offers aligners) who is:

- **Board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO)**
- A member of the **American Association of Orthodontists (AAO)**
- Experienced with your treatment type—especially adult Invisalign or complex bite/surgical cases
- Willing to show similar before-and-after cases and provide a written all-in price
- Convenient enough for regular visits; location matters more than people expect

Two good places to begin your shortlist are:

1. **American Board of Orthodontics directory** — find a board-certified orthodontist near your Phoenix ZIP code.  
2. **Invisalign doctor locator** — useful for finding experienced Invisalign providers, though “Diamond”/high-volume status alone does not guarantee the best result.

At consultations, ask:

- “Are you an orthodontist and ABO board-certified?”
- “Would braces or Invisalign give me the better result, and why?”
- “Is the quoted fee truly all-inclusive—retainers, refinements, X-rays, broken brackets, and emergency visits?”
- “How often will I see the orthodontist personally?”
- “Can I see cases similar to mine?”

A reasonable approach is to get **two or three complimentary consultations**. In Phoenix, treatment fees can vary substantially, and the best provider is usually the one with strong credentials, a clear treatment plan, and a team you trust—not necessarily the cheapest or the highest-volume Invisalign office.

If you share your **Phoenix-area ZIP code**, whether the patient is an **adult or child**, and whether you prefer **Invisalign vs. braces**, I can help you narrow the search to a practical shortlist.
